title: GTA6 Leaker CyberLeek Returns With New Lucia Footage
description: GTA6 leaker CyberLeek is back with another video showing Lucia in the street. The footage is currently being shared natively on X.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Leaker CyberLeek Returns With New Footage

Unsponsored leaks and community rumors surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 continue to circulate online. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, the notorious leaker known as "CyberLeek" has made another appearance, releasing a new video tied to Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title.

## Details of the Latest Leak

The newly surfaced video features one of the game's protagonists, Lucia. The footage displays her standing in a street setting, marked with the overlay of the Cyberleek logo. Because the video is being shared natively across platforms like X, many users browsing their feeds are encountering the unverified material directly.

## Context and Community Impact

The Grand Theft Auto community has historically been a prime target for leaks, datamining, and speculative content. While any glimpse of Lucia or other in-game elements tends to generate massive online discussion, these snippets remain entirely unofficial. Observers and media outlets continue to advise caution when browsing social media feeds, as such material often stems from unauthorized or early development builds rather than official developer communications.

## Editor's Take

While internet leaks always create a stir, players should approach unverified social media clips with a healthy dose of skepticism. Staying tuned for official updates from Rockstar Games remains the best way to experience GTA6 as intended.
